Apple (AAPL) vs NVIDIA (NVDA): on the same formula, their operating margins are 27.4 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AAPL: $478.8B · NVDA: $215.9B
• Revenue growth — AAPL: +15.1% · NVDA: +65.5%
• Operating margin — AAPL: 33.0% · NVDA: 60.4%
• Net margin — AAPL: 27.6% · NVDA: 55.6%
• Free cash flow margin — AAPL: 28.4% · NVDA: 44.8%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AAPL: 5.0% · NVDA: 68.3%

Different fiscal years: AAPL Sep 26, 2026 · NVDA Jan 25, 2026. The periods are not identical.
